What is linewatch? 

Linewatch operations are conducted by Border Patrol agents near international boundaries and coast lines in areas of Border Patrol jurisdiction to prevent the illegal entry and smuggling of individuals into the U.S.

Learn more: https://t.co/PFEFW19rF7. https://t.co/mjHSLt7jpG

TIME'S UP for counterfeit watch smugglers!

At the Port of Louisville, U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers seized a shipment on July 9 containing 200 counterfeit watches. Had these watches been genuine, the shipment would have had a combined manufacturer’s suggested retail price of over $28 million.

Read more: https://t.co/3uoXdK5qBI
